summary: NatWest Group plc furnished a Form 6-K carrying a London Stock Exchange PDMR notification under Article 19 of the UK Market Abuse Regulation (the US-equivalent Form 4 insider transaction disclosure). The filing reports that the trustee of the Company's Buy As You Earn Share Plan purchased 24 ordinary shares at 6.3786 per share on 28 October 2026 for James Holian, Chief Customer Operations Officer, on the London Stock Exchange. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are stated. This is a routine employee share-plan purchase notice, not a special situation; nothing for a risk-arb angle.
